title: Pocket Fighter (Japan): built-in instruction edit
summary: Preserve both upstream cartridge-initialization and instruction workarounds during sector delivery.
rationale: The original callback makes three adjacent longword writes at 06013F48..06013F50 and a NOP at 0602DD68. The twelve-byte replacement marks the game's existing cartridge-state record present with type 5C and returns, bypassing its ASR0/AREF setup and RAM test. The earlier recipe omitted this routine replacement. Retain both upstream effects for this exact image; the FAD 191 guard binds the reused PC-relative cartridge-state literal. Ordinary Saturn bus setup is not inherently incorrect. This preserves SAROO's compatibility behavior, without changing firmware, cartridge policy or the original BIN/CUE. The corrected source and native comparison from cdf6dba9 supersedes the earlier one-edit recipe. Physical game acceptance remains open.

writes.effect: Replace the first twelve bytes of cartridge initialization with the upstream present/type-5C return routine.
writes.reason: Preserve all three upstream longword writes, including the RTS delay-slot store, without running the game's cartridge-bus setup and RAM test.

writes.effect: Replace the first-read program instruction at 0602DD68 with a SH-2 NOP.
writes.reason: Match SAROO's existing Pocket Fighter compatibility edit before the program is loaded.

guards.reason: Bind the complete original sector containing the PC-relative cartridge-state literal 060383C0 at raw offset 132 (RAM 06014074).
